title: Easy 45min + ENERVIT CARBO GEL PRODUCT TEST
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 45min flat and easy. The run is the vehicle, not the point.
GYM: hip abductor block.
FUEL, THE POINT OF THE DAY: first ever exposure to Enervit Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro at rate. 2 gels, at minute 15 and minute 35, each washed with 200ml water. Carry a 500ml Isocarb bottle and finish it inside the 45min - 125ml every 15min, on the clock, not to thirst. Write down what the stomach did.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day.
WHY: 30 Aug proved the rate goes down - 178g in 1h51, about 96 g/h, with a clean gut - but it proved it on the wrong gel. SiS went in instead of Enervit because of a packing error, so the race gel has still never been taken at rate. Testing it for the first time on 5 September would make that day a product test and a duration test at once, which is one variable too many nine days out. This costs 45 easy minutes and removes it.
